plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Smartoptics transmission device. It reports uptime, temperature, fan, interface traffic, and power (enterprise PEN 30826).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Highest Smartoptics DCP environmental temperature in degrees Celsius. The raw dcpEnvMonTemperatureValue is in tenths of a degree, so the query divides it by 10. High values may indicate cooling problems, high ambient temperature or overloaded hardware.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Worst Smartoptics DCP fan status from dcpEnvMonFanStatus, normalized so ok(2) and notPresent(1) are healthy (1) and alarm(3) or any other code is fault (2). A value greater than 1 indicates a cooling-module fault that can lead to overheating.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Optional Smartoptics DCP fan rotation speed in RPM from dcpEnvMonFanSpeed, taken as the maximum across fans. The column is SKU-dependent; models without a speed reading simply omit this metric. Abnormally low or zero RPM indicates a stalled or failed fan.

metrics.name: device_power_watts
metrics.description: Optional Smartoptics DCP power consumption in watts from dcpEnvMonPowerConsumptionValue, taken as the maximum across sensors. The table is SKU-dependent; models without a consumption sensor simply omit this metric.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
